purpose: Define the acceptance contract for the future mecha_engine.genome package module before moving validator code out of labs/grid_genome.

external_references.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validation specification
external_references.used_for: Schema validation vocabulary and validity terminology.

required_public_surface.name: ValidationResult
required_public_surface.contract: Dataclass-like result with ok: bool, errors: list[str], warnings: list[str].

required_public_surface.name: validate_grid
required_public_surface.contract: Validate an in-memory grid dictionary without mutating input and without throwing for ordinary invalid payloads.

required_public_surface.name: validate_grid_file
required_public_surface.contract: Load and validate a JSON grid file using the same semantic checks as validate_grid.

required_public_surface.name: grid_signature
required_public_surface.contract: Return a deterministic semantic signature for a grid.

required_public_surface.name: render_packet_from_grid
required_public_surface.signature: render_packet_from_grid(grid: dict, state: dict | None = None) -> dict
required_public_surface.contract: Return a JSON-serializable renderer-neutral data packet.

validation_acceptance: Reject missing required sensor or expression organ.
Reject organ coordinates that do not match a real cell.
Reject required body cores with fewer than 4 cells.
Reject disconnected required body cores using 8-neighbor connectivity.
Reject cell and mutation values outside 0..1.
Return structured errors without throwing for ordinary invalid payloads.
Do not mutate the input dictionary.
negative_checks: package tests mutate sys.path to reach labs
package code silently accepts a known invalid counterexample
package code mutates input grids during validation
package implementation skips the frozen seed/invalid corpora
future_verification_commands: python -c "from mecha_engine.genome import validate_grid, validate_grid_file, grid_signature, render_packet_from_grid"
next_research_step: Use this gate as the first implementation acceptance checklist when the user explicitly starts package scaffold or genome package work.
